chapters.title: The tablets of Tarhuna
chapters.text: The writ names the Tarhuna archive. Reach the scribal city and take the tablets under seal.

chapters.title: The Salt Crossing
chapters.text: Carry the tablets through the outlaw roads to the Salt Crossing. Nothing written survives water.

chapters.title: The Drowned Mile
chapters.text: Reach Lower Ugra before the tide takes the harbour. Hold the quay until the ship is ready.

chapters.title: The Kings' Ford
chapters.text: The writ names the ford. Clear it.

chapters.title: The Muster season
chapters.text: Hold the ford for the Muster season. They will come back with more.

ships.name: Get one named hero to the ships

chapters.title: The river road
chapters.text: The writ names a hero and a harbour. Reach Ashkelu with them alive.

chapters.title: The Drowned Mile
chapters.text: The tide road. Hold until the way is clear.

chapters.title: Lower Ugra
chapters.text: The quay. The named one boards, whoever else is standing.

chapters.title: Ashkelu's temple
chapters.text: The Temple at Ashkelu holds the ink of half the levy. The writ, quietly, wants it gone.

chapters.title: The Salt Crossing
chapters.text: The priests have hired spears. They are waiting at the crossing.

chapters.title: The drowning
chapters.text: Open the sluices under the Temple and hold the doors until the Sea has it.

found.name: Found a city in the ruins

chapters.title: The Tin Steps
chapters.text: Beyond the pass there is a ruin the tablets still list as a city.

chapters.title: Clearing the ruin
chapters.text: Something has been sleeping in the cisterns.

chapters.title: The settlers
chapters.text: Bring the settlers up the goat path with their carts.

chapters.title: The first winter
chapters.text: Hold the walls through the first winter. If they stand, it is a city.
